plays.summary: White takes possession on the far touchline and attempts to build into midfield before Navy presses and wins the ball.

players.note: Stepped into the passing lane at the right moment, reminiscent of N'Golo Kante reading midfield build-up.
Check shoulders before playing inside under pressure; play the simpler wide option when midfielders are marked.

plays.summary: Navy launches a long ball into the right channel, but the White defender recovers to shield it and pass back to his goalkeeper to clear.

players.note: Look to support the runner closer rather than hitting a hopeful long ball when defenders have a head start.
Curve the run to stay inside the defender's blind spot and gain a step on the long ball.
Composed recovery run and calm back-pass under pressure, just like Virgil van Dijk managing space in behind.
Clean first-time clearance under pressure, similar to Alisson Becker sweeping behind a high line.

plays.summary: White tries to settle the ball in midfield after the clearance, but Navy presses aggressively and wins possession back.

players.note: Quickly closed down the receiver to force a turnover, reminiscent of Casemiro disrupting midfield rhythm.
Take the first touch away from incoming pressure instead of dribbling back into traffic.

plays.summary: Navy drives through midfield and threads a pass down the right wing, resulting in a cross-shot that sails high across the penalty area.

players.note: Sharp turn away from pressure and incisive through ball, reminiscent of Kevin De Bruyne opening up a defense.
Lift your head before striking on the run; squaring a low cutback across the six-yard box was the higher-percentage option.
Force the winger wider toward the touchline sooner rather than allowing an angle inside the box.

plays.summary: Navy's right winger keeps the ball in near the corner and dribbles against two defenders before White blocks it behind for a corner kick.

players.note: Strong persistence to retain possession in a tight space, similar to Bukayo Saka working the right byline.
Disciplined 1v1 defending without diving in to win the block, reminiscent of Andrew Robertson holding his line.
Provided timely cover support to double-team the winger near the byline.

plays.summary: Navy players walk over to set up for a corner kick from the right side.
Navy delivers the corner kick into the six-yard box, where the White goalkeeper and defense clear it out for another corner.

players.note: Whipped a dangerous ball right into the six-yard corridor, similar to Trent Alexander-Arnold's corner deliveries.
Decisive punch/claim in traffic to prevent a close-range header, like David Raya commanding his six-yard box.

plays.summary: Teams organize inside the penalty area as Navy prepares to take a second consecutive corner kick from the right.
Navy swings the second corner kick to the back post, and White's defense wins the aerial duel and clears the ball upfield.

players.note: Vary the delivery height so the goalkeeper and back-post defenders cannot easily clear under minimal pressure.
Commanding defensive header under pressure to clear danger, reminiscent of Ruben Dias attacking set pieces.

plays.summary: Both teams contest the clearance in midfield before Navy's left-back receives the ball and launches a long diagonal pass down the left wing.

players.note: Crisp diagonal switch into space behind the defense, reminiscent of Jordi Alba springing a counter-attack.
Secure the second ball with a clean first touch to prevent an immediate counter-pass.

plays.summary: Navy's right winger chases down the long ball near the corner, cuts inside past a defender, and feeds a midfielder at the top of the box.

players.note: Sharp control on the run and composed cut inside to keep the attack alive, similar to Mohamed Salah holding width.
Stay goal-side and force the attacker toward the touchline instead of letting him cut back inside.

plays.summary: Navy threads a pass into the box for a low strike on target, but White's goalkeeper dives cleanly to make the save.

players.note: Incisive through pass into the striker's stride, reminiscent of Martin Odegaard unlocking a low block.
Good movement and quick strike, though placing it higher or across the keeper would make the save much harder.
Sharp low diving save and clean gather in a 1v1 moment, just like Thibaut Courtois shutting down the angle.

plays.summary: White's goalkeeper rolls the ball out to his centre-back, who shifts it wide to the right-back near the touchline.

players.note: Calm short distribution to initiate the build-up, like Ederson starting play from the back.
Clean first-time circulation out to the full-back.
Good body orientation to receive open to the pitch.

plays.summary: White's right-back dribbles up the touchline and cuts inside under double-team pressure, drawing a foul near midfield.

players.note: Contain the ball carrier rather than lunging in from behind and conceding a free kick.
Brave dribbling out of tight pressure to win a foul and relieve the team, reminiscent of Achraf Hakimi advancing up the flank.

plays.summary: White sends the free kick forward into midfield, where Navy wins the second ball and regains possession.

players.note: Read the flight of the ball well to win the aerial second ball cleanly.
Play a shorter pass to feet rather than a 50-50 aerial ball into a crowded midfield.

plays.summary: Navy breaks quickly down the right flank into the penalty box, and White's defender blocks the final shot-cross out for a corner.

players.note: Quick vertical pass into space to launch the transition, reminiscent of Bruno Fernandes.
Explosive pace to attack the box, though an earlier cutback to the penalty spot was open.
Clutch recovery sprint and sliding block to deny a clear chance, similar to Kyle Walker's recovery defending.

plays.summary: Navy prepares to take a corner kick from the right side as players take their positions in the box.
Navy whips the corner kick into the box, where White clears and wins a free kick for an attacking foul.

players.note: Keep the delivery away from the goalkeeper's immediate reach.
Stood strong in a crowded box to draw the foul and relieve pressure.

plays.summary: White takes the free kick short inside the box and works the ball out cleanly toward midfield.

players.note: Patiently built out from the free kick without panicking.

plays.summary: White strings passes across midfield on the far side before Navy disrupts play and wins possession near the center circle.

players.note: Good pressing trap on the far side to force the turnover.
Move the ball with one or two touches before Navy's midfield press closes the passing lanes.

plays.summary: Play stops briefly near the far touchline as White sets up for a restart.
White plays forward from the far touchline, Navy intercepts and sends a ball down the left wing that runs out of play.

players.note: Check your run so the ball does not roll past the endline before you can cut it back.
Tracked the run well to shield the ball safely out of play.

plays.summary: Players reset during a dead-ball stoppage on the far side before White resumes play.
White sends a long through ball down their left wing into space, and Navy's orange goalkeeper rushes out to claim it.

players.note: Brave sweeper-keeper sprint off his line to snuff out a 1v1 threat, just like Manuel Neuer.
Visionary long ball behind the back line to spring the winger, reminiscent of Toni Kroos.
Explosive off-ball run to threaten behind the defense.

plays.summary: White regains possession on the bottom touchline, drives down the wing, and whips in a cross that Navy's goalkeeper catches cleanly.

players.note: Confident high catch in traffic to end the attack, similar to Gianluigi Donnarumma claiming crosses.
Direct wing play and dangerous delivery into the box, reminiscent of Gabriel Martinelli stretching the defense.
